name: Separable Convolution
definition: A method to compute holograms quickly using direct separable convolution if the lens phase function $f_z$ is linearly separable into vectors $f_{z_x}$ and $f_{z_y}$.
summary: Separable convolution accelerates hologram computation by decomposing the lens phase function into independent horizontal and vertical components, distinguishing itself from FFT-based methods through its reliance on spatial separability.
